risk_summary: The excerpt presents a predominantly positive operating outlook supported by record bookings, backlog, acquisitions, and quantified segment trends. It acknowledges material risks from supply-chain constraints, labor availability, inflation, tariffs, currency fluctuations, COVID-19 uncertainty, and tax-estimation judgments, but mitigation language is partly qualified and forward-looking. Disclosure is generally detailed and quantified, though lengthy, boilerplate-heavy, and reliant on estimates and expectations.
